name: Stoughton
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Stoughton, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Stoughton, MA: the Holiday Parade of Lights, Breakfast with Santa and holiday crafts at IKEA, and the historic 1888 train station.
lede: Stoughton's Christmas centers on the Holiday Parade of Lights, a December evening parade run by Stoughton Recreation, with Santa, local groups and music.
celebrates: The Stoughton Recreation Department organizes the Holiday Parade of Lights each December, inviting local groups to register floats and units through stoughtonrec.org. Photos from the parade show Santa, jugglers, a Polar Express themed entry, the Stoughton High School marching band and the chorus of the Old Stoughton Musical Society. The town also has IKEA Stoughton, which holds holiday crafts days and a Breakfast with Santa in its Swedish Restaurant. In 2026 Stoughton is marking its 300th anniversary with a celebration that runs from January to December.
lastyear: Stoughton Recreation set the 2025 Holiday Parade of Lights for Saturday, December 13, at 5 pm, starting at the corner of Adams and Pearl Street. The Enterprise photographed the parade that night and captured Santa, jugglers, a Polar Express entry, the Stoughton High School marching band and the Old Stoughton Musical Society chorus performing. Groups that wanted to march were asked to register through stoughtonrec.org ahead of time.
facts: Stoughton has some very old holiday voices. The Old Stoughton Musical Society was founded on November 7, 1786, and calls itself the oldest continuously operating choral society in the United States, and its chorus performed in the 2025 Parade of Lights. 2026 is Stoughton's 300th anniversary year, and the town's 300th Anniversary Committee planned a celebration that runs from January through December 2026.
trains: Stoughton station is the end of the line: the terminus of the Stoughton Branch of the MBTA Providence/Stoughton Line. The branch first opened on April 7, 1845, and that same year the first station burned and its replacement blew down in the wind. The granite station building with its 62 foot clock tower, designed by Charles Brigham, opened in March 1888 and joined the National Register of Historic Places in 1974. For a holiday train ride, Edaville in Carver runs a train through the lights.

kidfact: Stoughton's train station has a clock tower 62 feet tall. When the railroad tore down the old station in 1890, it pulled the old tower over with a locomotive.
faq: When is the Stoughton Holiday Parade of Lights?

It is held on a Saturday evening in December. In 2025 Stoughton Recreation set it for Saturday, December 13, at 5 pm, starting at the corner of Adams and Pearl Street. Check stoughtonrec.org or the Stoughton Recreation social pages each fall for the current year's date, start point and float registration.
What can kids see at the Stoughton Parade of Lights?

Photos from the 2025 parade show Santa, jugglers, a Polar Express themed entry, lighted floats, the Stoughton High School marching band and the Old Stoughton Musical Society chorus. Local groups register their own units through Stoughton Recreation, so the lineup changes a little every year.
Is there a train to Stoughton from Boston?

Yes. Stoughton station is the last stop on the Stoughton Branch of the MBTA Providence/Stoughton Line, with trains from South Station. The station building, a granite depot with a 62 foot clock tower designed by Charles Brigham, opened in 1888 and is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
What is the Old Stoughton Musical Society?

It is a chorus founded in Stoughton on November 7, 1786, and it describes itself as the oldest continuously operating choral society in the United States. Families can hear it at holiday time, since its chorus sang in the 2025 Stoughton Holiday Parade of Lights.

2026 is Stoughton's 300th anniversary year. The town's 300th Anniversary Committee planned a yearlong celebration running from January through December 2026, which opened with a kickoff event at Stoughton High School in January and included a town block party near Wyman Street in June.
